source_treatment: Accepted factual handoff; source proofs not audited.

networks.dataset: Zachary karate club, NetworkX built-in, unweighted

anderson.use: Distinguish finite-sample metallic appearance from the accepted infinite-volume limit.

haldane.projection_status: Exponential extrapolation of accepted L<=16 data; new larger-chain calculation required.

lieb_thirring.status: Bounds for one spin state, hbar^2/(2m)=1; not measured material properties.

crystals.status: Numerical resolution for comparing the two accepted lattice energies, not a melting prediction.

chaos.status: Area-average entropy gives a heuristic; orbitwise finite-time quantiles still need measurement.

smooth_numbers.status: Asymptotic smoothness priors; finite-key error bounds and stage-1 prime-power conditions remain to be studied.

agenda.delivered: Dephasing-aware X/Z encoding rule and achievable rates.
agenda.question: Can encoding selected from measured T1,T2 and readout error improve stored classical information?
agenda.next_experiment: Randomize X and Z encodings on the same qubits, measure confusion matrices versus idle time, and estimate mutual information with confidence intervals.

agenda.delivered: Minimum photon budget against fraction-and-power-optimized time sharing.
agenda.question: How much of the ideal photon saving survives finite-block joint detection and uncertain optical loss?
agenda.next_experiment: Apply identical two-user rate demands and photon counting to both schemes; fit receiver penalties separately from transmission loss.

agenda.delivered: Accepted finite-size data translated into an experimental scale question.
agenda.question: At what length, phase-coherence time and disorder does a 2D sample cross from apparent metal to insulating response?
agenda.next_experiment: Measure quasi-1D transfer-matrix localization lengths, then vary sample length and dephasing; keep symmetry class and Hamiltonian within the stated model.

agenda.delivered: Edge/bulk separation and a labeled chain-length projection.
agenda.question: Which symmetry-preserving disorder or anisotropy retains a usable edge state while leaving the bulk gapped?
agenda.next_experiment: Use DMRG on L=20,30,40 with controlled perturbations; resolve edge splitting and bulk excitation separately.

agenda.delivered: Inverted depletion law for a 2% signal at a specified density.
agenda.question: Can quantum depletion be separated from thermal and trap-induced depletion at accessible signal strength?
agenda.next_experiment: Sweep scattering length across the calculated target and measure condensate fraction and high-k contact jointly, including a temperature series.

agenda.delivered: Improved kinetic and density-compression lower bounds.
agenda.question: Can the tighter bound prune inadmissible trial densities or certify useful energy intervals?
agenda.next_experiment: For fixed spin convention, compute kinetic energy and integral rho^(5/3) in benchmark trial states; compare interval widths under both constants.

agenda.delivered: Energy precision required to distinguish square and triangular lattices.
agenda.question: How do substrate pinning, defects or a weak attractive interaction compete with the triangular reference?
agenda.next_experiment: Compute defect formation energies at fixed density and screening, then introduce perturbations explicitly outside universal-optimality assumptions.

agenda.delivered: An entropy-to-precision planning rule from accepted numerical outputs.
agenda.question: Can orbitwise error-growth quantiles predict reliable forecast horizons near stable islands?
agenda.next_experiment: Use paired perturbed trajectories at K=10,20,100 and accelerator-mode windows; compare first-passage times with finite-time Lyapunov quantiles.

agenda.delivered: Exact permitted-edge repair and a quantitative stationary abundance floor.
agenda.question: Can a chemically feasible minimum repair maintain desired species abundance over an operational timescale?
agenda.next_experiment: Constrain candidate reactions by stoichiometry and thermodynamics, then test rates and abundance floors; add stochastic extinction analysis for small copy numbers.

agenda.delivered: Three degree-preserving motif tails with multi-chain diagnostics.
agenda.question: Which purported biological motifs remain unusual after the relevant structural constraints are preserved?
agenda.next_experiment: Start with an undirected interaction dataset and prespecified motifs; compare degree-only and compartment-aware nulls, establishing mixing separately for additional constraints.

agenda.delivered: Accepted model outputs retained as finite-benchmark priors.
agenda.question: How accurately do asymptotic smoothness laws rank algorithms at finite problem sizes?
agenda.next_experiment: Benchmark random and structured integer ensembles with explicit prime-power conditions for Pollard stage 1; quantify finite-size model error.

agenda.delivered: Exact membership turnover, Jaccard similarity and a mass-dependent error budget.
agenda.question: Can rare-population membership checks prevent stable-looking aggregate transport predictions from masking unstable assignments?
agenda.next_experiment: Reweight held-out rare groups over several orders of magnitude; bootstrap maps and score group-membership overlap alongside aggregate distribution fit.
